author: Paul Walsh
title: Edina day care owner tied to Feeding Our Future admits to more than $5 million in fraud
supports: Contemporaneous federal-court reporting states that Fahima Egeh Mahamud pleaded guilty on July 9, 2026 in U.S. District Court to wire fraud and conspiracy to defraud the United States.
The report separately describes approximately $4.6 million tied to false child-care claims and approximately $850,000 tied to false or inflated federal child-nutrition claims.
does_not_support: A DOJ-issued scheme-wide conviction ordinal for Mahamud.
A reason DOJ later corrected Abdirashid Bixi Dool's public ordinal to 68 rather than 69.
